title: Held-out CBC combination: low hemoglobin plus low WBC

patient_context.chief_complaint: Explain a held-out combination of CBC abnormalities without forcing a unifying diagnosis.
patient_context.history: No symptoms, medication context, differential count, reticulocyte count or prior trend is supplied.

interaction.prompt: Explain the held-out two-abnormality pattern. Do not assume one disease must explain both values unless the evidence supports it.

must_include: Identify both low hemoglobin and low WBC as observations.
Explain that each abnormality is nonspecific and that the combination still does not establish one cause from CBC alone.
State what categories of additional context would be needed before etiologic interpretation.
must_not_claim: Do not diagnose marrow failure or cancer from the combination alone.
Do not assume both abnormalities have the same cause.

forbidden_claims: low hemoglobin plus low WBC confirms cancer
both abnormalities must share one cause

critical_errors: Assigns a definitive severe diagnosis from the combination alone.
